subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should `models.authStatus` treat token/setup-token profiles as the fallback status source for OAuth-configured providers when no effective OAuth profile exists?
rationale: That policy fixes the reported setup-token false warning but changes compatibility-sensitive status behavior for existing OAuth and token profile combinations.

options.title: Accept OAuth-first token fallback
options.body: Land this PR with OAuth taking priority and token/setup-token profiles satisfying provider status only when no effective OAuth profile exists.

options.title: Pause for a different auth-status policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want token-only migrations handled in runtime or doctor policy instead of the gateway status projection.

recommendation.title: Accept OAuth-first token fallback
recommendation.body: Land this PR with OAuth taking priority and token/setup-token profiles satisfying provider status only when no effective OAuth profile exists.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest token-auth/setup-token history and is already assigned on the PR with prepared proof.
